items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy suggested it and created it basically... I would say Hal was probably suggested by Jimmy. Jimmy was certainly sympathetic with that music.

ctx.x: I think Norman Granz had some suggestion about that. That’s all I really know about that. Jimmy suggested it and created it basically.
Did you decide who was going to be in the section? Because it’s Hal McKusick, Warne, Ted Brown, and Jimmy Giuffre. Were those your choices?
